name: Outlaw (PRE ALPHA)
desc:
❓ "Outlaw" is a Open World experience that revolves mainly around Police VS Criminals!
🤑 Read the tutorial/help in game to learn more!

Game is in (Pre Alpha) please expect bugs and unfinished features. Game is actively being developed every day!
⚠️Please report any bugs or suggestions to the server or group, thanks!

💸 Work a job at different places in the city to make money legally.
💰 Rob different places in the city to make money illegally, receiving a wanted level by the Cops.
👮 Arrest wanted players and earn XP, you also receive paychecks every 5 minutes!
🔫 Purchase guns at the "Guns 4 Less" or "High End Gun store".
🏨 Rent different apartments around the map to live in!
🏎️ Purchase different cars and drive throughout the large beautifully detailed map.
🎮 All devices!

❗Released on 10/04/2024
